about: Native-only text substitutions where clang rejects VC6 dialect that native_units.py cannot rewrite generically. Each must keep the original behaviour; migrate a fixup into src/ once the exact build proves the edited file still matches, then delete it here. 'verified' says whether the chosen meaning was checked against the original code.

fixups.why: DynamicVectorClass<int>: Delete(int) and Delete(int const &) are ambiguous in ISO C++; VC6 resolved it. Native picks delete-by-index (selected is an index into choices).
